concept: À 2 h du matin, une boîte de réception déborde dans un bureau vide : des agents IA conçus dans le studio partent en fils de lumière à travers la ville endormie, trient, rédigent, puis s'arrêtent net et attendent. Au matin, un seul pouce sur « Approuver » libère l'envoi, et l'équipe arrive devant un travail déjà fait.
accroche: Gros plan d'un portable seul dans un bureau désert la nuit, l'écran qui se remplit de formes lumineuses en cascade, surtitre « 2 H DU MATIN », puis coupe sec sur le vrai canevas de flux tri → brouillon → approbation.
produit_evident: À 2,4 s, l'insert réel du canevas WorkStudio (tri → rédaction → approbation) avec le titre « Vos agents IA prennent le relais », puis le surtitre « STUDIO D'AGENTS IA » : on voit un outil qui conçoit des agents qui traitent les courriels.

plans.intention: Accroche : la nuit, la boîte de réception déborde, personne n'est là.
plans.image: Low angle from the desk surface, extreme close-up of an open laptop alone on a desk in a dark empty office at night, the screen filled with soft out-of-focus glowing rectangles stacking in rows, cool blue light spilling over the keyboard and a forgotten mug, floor-to-ceiling windows behind with blurred city lights, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, deep navy and cyan palette with one amber accent, cinematic photograph, no readable text
plans.mouvement: Blurred glowing rectangles keep stacking and sliding down the screen faster and faster, light flickering on the keys; very slow push-in toward the screen.
plans.son: quiet office hum, soft notification chimes piling up
plans.camera: 85 mm, poussée lente au ras du bureau

plans.intention: Le produit, tout de suite : le vrai canevas tri → brouillon → approbation.
Le travail invisible prend son envol : les agents partent en fils de lumière vers la ville.
plans.image: Wide shot from behind an open glowing laptop on a desk in a dark empty office at night, dozens of thin luminous amber and cyan light lines rising from the laptop and streaming across the room through floor-to-ceiling windows into the night city skyline, empty chairs in silhouette, long exposure feel, 24mm lens, symmetrical composition, deep blue darkness with warm light trails, cinematic photograph, no text
plans.mouvement: Thin light lines flow smoothly from the laptop toward the windows and out over the city; camera pushes slowly forward between the empty chairs toward the glass.
plans.camera: 24 mm, travelling avant entre les chaises

plans.intention: L'ampleur : un réseau de lumière relie la ville endormie.
plans.image: High aerial view of a sleeping city at night, dark towers and quiet streets, fine glowing amber and cyan light filaments threading between buildings like a living network, connecting rooftops and windows, light mist low over the streets, a curved river crossing the frame, 35mm lens from a drone, wide composition, deep navy palette with warm filaments, cinematic night photography, no signs, no text
plans.mouvement: Light filaments travel between buildings and pulse along their paths; slow forward drone glide with a gentle descending tilt.
plans.son: distant city night wind, low hum

plans.intention: Le tri : un flux entre, se sépare en trois.
plans.image: Top-down view of a long dark varnished wooden table in an empty boardroom at night, a single glowing cyan light stream arriving from the left and splitting cleanly into three separate parallel beams that run toward three simple empty trays, soft reflections on the wood, 35mm lens, graphic geometric composition, dark teal and black palette with luminous lines, cinematic photograph, no text
plans.mouvement: The light stream flows in from the left and splits into three beams gliding toward the trays; slow overhead crane drift along the table.

plans.intention: La rédaction : la réponse prend forme, illisible et chaude.
plans.image: Close-up of a single blank sheet of paper on a dark desk under a low warm desk lamp at night, fine threads of amber light descending onto the page and settling into soft glowing horizontal lines like a letter taking shape, dust floating in the lamp beam, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm amber and deep brown palette, cinematic still life photograph, no legible writing
plans.mouvement: Amber light threads drift down and settle as soft glowing lines on the paper; dust floats in the lamp beam; slow push-in.

plans.intention: La récompense : l'agent s'arrête au seuil et attend l'humain.
plans.image: A single small sphere of warm amber light hovering motionless just before the edge of a dark glass desk at night, beside a closed laptop, its glow reflected in the glass surface, empty dark office behind with soft blurred city lights, 85mm lens, centered composition with wide negative space, deep blue darkness and one warm point of light, calm patient mood, cinematic photograph, no text
plans.mouvement: The light sphere hovers in place, gently pulsing like slow breathing; its reflection shimmers on the glass; very slow lateral orbit around it.

plans.intention: Pendant ce temps, vous dormez, en paix.
plans.image: Dark bedroom at night seen from the foot of the bed, a person asleep under a white duvet seen from behind, head turned away into the pillow, a phone lying face down on the nightstand with a faint warm glow at its edges, blue moonlight through sheer curtains, 35mm lens, wide calm composition, deep blue and soft silver palette, cinematic photograph
plans.mouvement: Sheer curtains breathe slowly in the night air, moonlight shifts softly across the duvet; very slow push-in toward the nightstand.
plans.son: quiet room tone, slow breathing, faint distant traffic

plans.intention: La nuit continue : les fils de lumière traversent la ville sous la pluie.
plans.image: Street level view of a wet empty downtown avenue at night in light rain, thin luminous amber and cyan light lines streaming overhead between the dark towers, long reflections on the wet asphalt, no people, no cars, 24mm lens, low angle, symmetrical vanishing point, deep navy palette with warm reflections, cinematic night photograph, no signs, no text
plans.mouvement: Rain falls steadily, light lines flow overhead toward the vanishing point, ripples spread on the puddles; slow forward dolly along the avenue.
plans.son: soft rain on asphalt, electric hum overhead

plans.intention: Respiration : l'aube, les derniers fils s'éteignent dans le ciel.
plans.image: Wide view of a city skyline at dawn from a high rooftop, first golden sunlight breaking on the horizon, the last faint amber light lines dissolving into the warm sky above the towers, soft fog in the streets below, 50mm lens, horizon on the lower third, palette shifting from deep blue to warm gold and peach, serene cinematic photograph, no text
plans.mouvement: The sun slowly rises, golden light spreads across the towers, the faint light lines fade into the sky; slow crane up.

plans.intention: Le matin : vous retrouvez votre téléphone, sereinement.
plans.image: Morning in a bright apartment, a person seen from behind standing at a large window in a soft grey sweater, holding a phone at chest height, golden sunrise light over the city outside, warm rim light around their shoulders and hair, plants on the windowsill, 35mm lens, back view silhouette, warm gold and soft white palette, cinematic photograph
plans.mouvement: The person stands calmly, dust glows in the slanted sunbeams, light flares softly through the glass; slow push-in over their shoulder.

plans.intention: Une seule chose à faire : décider.
plans.image: Over-the-shoulder close view of a hand holding a smartphone in warm morning light, the screen showing only one soft blurred glowing card shape, the city at sunrise out of focus in the background, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm gold and cream palette, intimate cinematic photograph, no readable text
plans.mouvement: The glowing card shape on the screen gently brightens; sunlight flickers across the hand; very slow push-in toward the screen.

plans.intention: La preuve réelle : la carte d'approbation et son bouton « Approuver ».
Le geste décisif : le pouce humain.
plans.image: Extreme macro close-up of a thumb about to touch a smartphone screen glowing with one soft warm blurred button shape, golden morning sunlight, fine skin detail, out-of-focus window light behind, 100mm macro lens, very shallow depth of field, warm amber and gold palette, decisive moment, cinematic photograph, no readable text

plans.camera: 100 mm macro, fixe avec légère poussée

plans.intention: L'envoi : un seul trait de lumière file au-dessus de la ville au soleil.
plans.image: Wide view from inside a sunlit apartment through a large window over a city in the morning, one bright streak of warm golden light shooting from the window across the sky over the rooftops toward the horizon, leaving a soft glowing trail, clear blue morning sky, 24mm lens, wide dynamic composition, gold and sky blue palette, euphoric cinematic photograph, no text
plans.mouvement: A single bright light streak launches from the window and races across the sky over the rooftops, leaving a glowing trail; camera tilts up and follows it.

plans.intention: L'équipe arrive devant un travail déjà fait.
plans.image: Bright open-plan office in the morning, sunlight pouring through floor-to-ceiling windows, three colleagues seen from behind walking calmly toward their desks carrying jackets and bags, tidy desks and green plants, long soft shadows on the floor, 35mm lens, wide shot, warm white and honey palette, relaxed cinematic photograph, no screens visible, no text

plans.intention: Le soulagement : du temps rendu à l'humain.
plans.image: Medium shot from behind of a person sitting at a sunlit desk leaning back in a chair, hands behind their head, an open laptop in front with a softly glowing blurred screen, a city in morning light through the window, relaxed posture, 50mm lens, warm gold and white palette, peaceful cinematic photograph, no readable text
plans.mouvement: The person leans back and stretches slowly, sunlight glows through the window; slow orbit from behind to the side.

plans.intention: Bouclage : le même portable qu'à 2 h, maintenant au soleil, une main posée. Dernière phrase.
plans.image: Low angle from the desk surface, close-up of an open laptop on a desk in an office in bright morning sunlight, the screen glowing with a few calm soft blurred shapes, a relaxed hand resting beside the keyboard, floor-to-ceiling windows behind with a sunlit city, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm gold and soft white palette, cinematic photograph, no readable text

plans.camera: 85 mm au ras du bureau, recul lent (raccord avec p01)

musique.genre: cinematic electronic, nocturnal pulse to sunrise anthem
musique.description: Opens with a lone ticking synth pulse and soft notification-like plucks, deep sub bass; builds with a shimmering arpeggiator and tight muted drums; drops to felt piano and airy pads for the sleeping night; a long string swell at dawn; a riser into a full euphoric drop with wide drums, bright synth lead, choir pad; resolves on warm piano and strings. Clean modern mix, strong transients on the hits, no vocals.

sections.description: lone ticking synth pulse, sparse plucks piling up, sub bass drone, tension
hard hit, shimmering arpeggiator enters, muted kick and hats, forward momentum
full groove, snare on hits, rhythmic stabs synced to cuts
drums drop out, felt piano melody and airy pads, intimate and tender
slow string swell, warm brass pad, light breaking, hopeful
riser and ticking pulse return, held breath, tension building
euphoric drop, wide drums, bright synth lead, choir pad, release
drums fall away, warm piano and strings resolve the theme

fin.sous_titre: Le studio pour concevoir vos agents IA et leurs flux, avec approbation humaine avant chaque envoi.
fin.mentions: Images de synthèse. Interface réelle du produit.
